title: Karen, an experiencer who threw lamps at the beings

tellings.quote: Karen, one of the they used to throw things at them. I mean, she'd throw lamps.

plain: A woman named Karen, an "experiencer", meaning someone who says she has met non-human beings, is said to have fought back when they came by throwing things at them, even lamps. A man named Dan Sheehan tells Michels this at second hand, in connection with a man named John Mack. It would mean these encounters are physical enough that a person can hurl furniture at the visitors.
